events.title: ERASMUS PLEADS FOR PEACE
events.description: a tale by Frank Jacobs and Chris Reunes. What would peace tell us if she were a woman of flesh and blood? How would she convince us to stop war and violence? Erasmus asked himself this question back in 1517 because the world was on fire then too. He wrote THE LAMENTATION OF PEACE, a text that has remained meaningful, especially today. Frank JACOBS and Chris REUNES present to you THE LAMENTATION OF PEACE, with text excerpts, commentary and image projection. They also bring satirical dialogues in which Erasmus dismisses all violence as crime with razor-sharp mockery. An hour of laughter.
